questions.explain: The chapter's three-tier framework: Tier 1 = P50 over 30 days (sizing floor), Tier 2 = P95 (target utilization ceiling), Tier 3 = P99/max bursts classified as schedulable (offload to replica/scheduled scaling) or unpredictable (keep true headroom).
options: Average, median, and mode over 7 days
P95, P99, and P99.9 over 90 days

Minimum, maximum, and standard deviation over 14 days

questions.explain: Required vCPUs = ceil(P95_CPU_utilization_pct / 0.70 × current_vCPUs) and required RAM = ceil(working_set_GB / 0.75), where the working set is typically 15–30% of database size for OLTP; sizing so P95 uses ≤70% of capacity leaves a 2× headroom buffer.
options: vCPUs = ceil(P95% / 0.70 × current_vCPUs); RAM = ceil(working_set / 0.75)
vCPUs = average CPU% × 2; RAM = database size × 0.5
vCPUs = P99% / 0.50; RAM = freeable memory × 2
vCPUs = P50% / 0.90; RAM = buffer pool × 1.25

questions.explain: Resizing a Multi-AZ RDS instance causes a failover with roughly 30–60 seconds of interrupted connections; application teams must verify connection retry logic, and without it the resize becomes a deployment event.
options: No downtime at all — resizing is always online
About 5 minutes of complete outage on any instance
Only Single-AZ instances experience any interruption
Roughly 30–60 seconds of interrupted connections from the Multi-AZ failover — application retry logic must handle it
questions.q: What availability impact does resizing a Multi-AZ RDS instance have?

questions.explain: The correct sequence is: right-size the instance on-demand, observe for 30 days, then purchase the RI at the right-sized tier — buying a 3-year RI first locks in the wrong size; the chapter suggests gating the RI purchase form on a 'last right-sizing review date' field.
options: Buy the 3-year RI first, then right-size within the commitment
Right-size on-demand, observe 30 days, then purchase the RI at the right-sized tier
RIs and right-sizing are independent and can be done in any order
Never buy RIs — on-demand is always cheaper after right-sizing
questions.q: What sequencing does the chapter mandate between right-sizing and Reserved Instance purchases?
